newsitem.title: THAILAND: Trade in Bangkok Paint suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Bangkok Paint suspended.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) said on Friday it would suspend trading in shares of Bangkok Paint Industries from Monday.
The SET said in a statement it had earlier given 30 days to the company to provide it with some undisclosed information or face delisting. But the firm had failed to meet the deadline.
Bangkok Paint closed up 3.50 baht at 16 on Friday.
The company said recently it planned to issue 300 million new shares through private placement.
The share issue was part of a financial rescue plan which will see BPT increase its registered capital from 180 million baht to 3.18 billion baht, it had added.

Proceeds from the proposed increase would have helped fund the firm's planned 2.375 billion baht acquisition of 20.9 million shares, or 100 percent, of developer Suvit and Seri Co Ltd, conditional on the latter securing unspecified land for development.

Bangkok Paint was to have spent a further 657 million baht, paid in installments over 18 months, to buy three property projects, Seri Bagna 1, Seri Place and Seri Villa currently owned by property company Suvit and Seri Ltd.
